categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: landscaping and greening construction, comprehensive computing power services, and display driver chip business. The landscaping segment includes municipal public gardens, real estate landscaping, and ecological wetland projects. The computing power services segment involves sales, leasing, networking, and installation of computing servers and data center infrastructure. The display driver chip segment focuses on R&D, design, and sales of chips for LCD and high-resolution displays.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs mixed-signal design technology in chip development, focusing on analog and digital integration. It uses a fabless model for chip manufacturing, relying on wafer fabrication by third parties. For computing power services, it integrates hardware, system integration, and operation & maintenance management to provide comprehensive solutions. The landscaping business uses traditional construction and procurement methods with centralized and local sourcing strategies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include municipal governments, state-owned enterprises, real estate developers, and major panel manufacturers in China. The computing power services target cloud computing, data centers, intelligent security, autonomous driving, smart healthcare, consumer electronics, and industrial manufacturing sectors. The display driver chip business serves domestic mainstream panel manufacturers. The landscaping business mainly serves public infrastructure and real estate sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant revenue from Central China (Hubei), East China, and North China regions. It has subsidiaries in Wuhan, Suzhou, Dalian, Shenzhen, Shanghai, and Beijing. The company also has a subsidiary in South Korea related to semiconductor business. The domestic market is the primary focus, especially for display driver chips and landscaping services.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments. In the chip business, it is a fabless design and sales entity, focusing on R&D and customer solutions rather than wafer fabrication. In computing power services, it provides integrated solutions including hardware sales, leasing, and data center infrastructure services. In landscaping, it acts as a contractor and service provider in project construction and maintenance.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on expanding its computing power comprehensive services and display driver chip businesses while gradually shrinking the landscaping segment. R&D priorities include developing high-speed, low-power display driver chips supporting USI-T and ISP protocols, targeting 4K and 8K high-resolution displays. The company emphasizes innovation in chip design, system integration, and green low-carbon technologies in computing power services. It also plans to enhance governance, capital structure, and talent development to support transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through project-based construction contracts in landscaping, sales and leasing of computing power servers, and sales of display driver chips and related software services. The computing power segment includes sales, rental fees, and technical service fees. Landscaping revenue comes from public bidding and invited contracts. Display driver chip revenue derives from customized chip sales and technical support services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading integrated service provider in Central China’s landscaping market and is an emerging player in China’s computing power and display driver chip industries. It competes with other fabless chip design firms and computing service providers. The landscaping segment faces intense competition due to market fluctuations and real estate sector adjustments. The company aims to leverage its technical expertise and stable customer base to strengthen its market position in new strategic sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 231.6 million, a 224.3% increase from 2023, driven mainly by growth in computing power services. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 77.1 million, reflecting challenges in landscaping project collections and credit impairment provisions. Total assets were about RMB 920 million, with a slight decrease from the previous year. The company is undergoing a strategic transformation with increasing revenue contribution from computing power services (46.66%) and a declining share from landscaping (47.68%).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes integrated, end-to-end solutions in computing power services, combining hardware sales, leasing, network integration, and intelligent operation to accelerate customer deployment and reduce costs. In chip design, it leverages deep technical expertise and market-oriented R&D to provide customized, high-performance display driver chips for mainstream panel manufacturers. Its landscaping business offers comprehensive services from design to maintenance with strong local market presence and professional project execution. The company aims to differentiate through technological innovation, stable customer relationships, and a diversified business model.
